Corporate Tax Advisory.shortDescription: Legal guidance on corporate taxation, planning, compliance, and efficient structuring of transactions.
Corporate Tax Advisory.longDescription: We provide corporate tax advisory covering planning, structuring, and compliance matters, helping businesses make tax-efficient decisions while staying within legal boundaries.
benefits: Reduces tax risk in business decisions

process.title: Legal Analysis
process.description: Analyze applicable provisions and case law.

faqs.question: When should corporate tax advisory be sought?
faqs.answer: Before major transactions, restructuring, or investment decisions.

faqs.question: Is this different from tax return filing?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is strategic legal advisory, not routine compliance filing.

faqs.question: Can advisory help in future litigation?
faqs.answer: Yes, documented positions strengthen your case if disputed later.

Corporate Tax Litigation.shortDescription: Representing companies before tax authorities, tribunals, and courts in corporate tax disputes.
Corporate Tax Litigation.longDescription: We represent corporate clients through assessments, appeals, and tribunal proceedings, building strong legal arguments to contest disputed tax demands.

process.title: Case Assessment
process.description: Review the dispute and build litigation strategy.

faqs.question: What forums handle corporate tax disputes?
faqs.answer: Assessing Officer, CIT(A), ITAT, and higher courts.

faqs.question: How long does litigation typically take?
faqs.answer: It varies from months to years depending on complexity and forum.

faqs.question: Can settlement be pursued instead?
faqs.answer: Yes, certain dispute resolution schemes may offer faster settlement.

Income Tax Assessment Representation.shortDescription: Assisting companies during scrutiny, reassessment, and verification proceedings with legal representation.
Income Tax Assessment Representation.longDescription: We prepare comprehensive submissions and represent your company before assessing officers during scrutiny and reassessment proceedings.

process.title: Representation
process.description: Attend hearings and respond to queries.

faqs.question: What is reassessment?
faqs.answer: Reopening of a case where income is believed to have escaped assessment.

faqs.question: What is the time limit for reassessment?
faqs.answer: Generally up to 3 years, extendable to 10 years in specified cases.

faqs.question: Can reassessment be challenged?
faqs.answer: Yes, on jurisdictional or procedural grounds before appellate forums.

Tax Notice & Reply Services.shortDescription: Preparation and submission of legal responses to tax notices after reviewing allegations and records.
Tax Notice & Reply Services.longDescription: We analyze tax notices in detail and prepare comprehensive, legally sound replies backed by relevant records and case law.

process.title: Notice Analysis
process.description: Understand the notice and required response.

process.title: Reply Preparation
process.description: Draft reply with legal grounds and evidence.

process.title: Submission
process.description: File the reply before the deadline.

faqs.question: What happens if a notice is not answered?
faqs.answer: It may lead to an ex-parte order against the company.

faqs.question: Can extension be sought for reply?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, at the discretion of the officer.

faqs.question: Should legal counsel review every notice?
faqs.answer: Recommended for complex or high-value notices.

Tax Appeals & Tribunal Matters.shortDescription: Preparation and representation for appeals against tax orders before appellate authorities and tribunals.
Tax Appeals & Tribunal Matters.longDescription: We handle the full appeal process — drafting grounds, compiling evidence, and representing your company before CIT(A) and the Tribunal.
benefits: Preserves right to challenge adverse orders

process.title: Order Review
process.description: Analyze the order and identify grounds.

process.title: Appeal Drafting
process.description: Prepare the appeal with supporting documents.

faqs.question: What is the time limit to appeal?
faqs.answer: Generally 30-60 days from the order, depending on the forum.

faqs.question: Is pre-deposit mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, a specified percentage of disputed tax is generally required.

faqs.question: Can a Tribunal order be further appealed?
faqs.answer: Yes, to the High Court on substantial questions of law.

Corporate Tax Planning.shortDescription: Strategic legal planning for corporate taxation covering structuring, deductions, and compliance efficiency.
Corporate Tax Planning.longDescription: We help structure business operations, financing, and transactions in a tax-efficient, legally compliant manner aligned with your growth plans.
benefits: Aligns tax strategy with business goals

faqs.question: How is this different from tax advisory?
faqs.answer: Planning is proactive and strategic; advisory often addresses specific queries.

faqs.question: Does planning cover GST as well?
faqs.answer: It can be scoped to include indirect taxes alongside corporate tax.

faqs.question: When should planning be reviewed?
faqs.answer: Annually, or before major business or regulatory changes.

International Tax Advisory.shortDescription: Legal guidance on cross-border taxation, treaty benefits, and international structuring.
International Tax Advisory.longDescription: We advise on international tax matters including permanent establishment risk, treaty applicability, and cross-border transaction structuring.

process.title: Analysis
process.description: Assess PE risk and treaty applicability.

faqs.question: What is permanent establishment?
faqs.answer: A fixed place of business creating taxable presence in another country.

faqs.question: How do treaties reduce tax?
faqs.answer: Through lower withholding rates or exemption/credit mechanisms.

faqs.question: Is this relevant for small businesses?
faqs.answer: Mainly for businesses with cross-border transactions or foreign operations.

Transfer Pricing Legal Advisory.shortDescription: Legal advisory on transfer pricing regulations, documentation, and arm's-length compliance.
Transfer Pricing Legal Advisory.longDescription: We provide legal guidance on transfer pricing policy, documentation requirements, and defense strategy for related-party transactions.

process.title: Documentation Guidance
process.description: Support Form 3CEB and TP study preparation.

faqs.question: Who needs transfer pricing compliance?
faqs.answer: Entities with international or specified domestic related-party transactions.

faqs.question: What is arm's-length price?
faqs.answer: The price that would apply between unrelated parties in similar transactions.

faqs.question: What happens on non-compliance?
faqs.answer: Adjustments, penalties, and potential litigation may follow.

Withholding Tax Advisory.shortDescription: Legal advisory on withholding tax obligations for domestic and cross-border payments.
Withholding Tax Advisory.longDescription: We analyze applicable withholding tax rates and treaty relief for various payment types, ensuring compliant deduction on domestic and foreign remittances.

process.title: Rate Determination
process.description: Apply correct rate considering treaty relief.

faqs.question: Is withholding different for foreign payments?
faqs.answer: Yes, foreign remittances often require Form 15CA/15CB and treaty analysis.

faqs.question: What happens on short deduction?
faqs.answer: Interest, penalty, and disallowance of the expense may apply.

faqs.question: Can lower deduction certificates be obtained?
faqs.answer: Yes, under Section 197 for eligible cases.

Corporate Tax Due Diligence.shortDescription: Review of tax records and litigation history to identify potential risks before transactions.
Corporate Tax Due Diligence.longDescription: We conduct focused corporate tax due diligence ahead of M&A or investment transactions, identifying contingent liabilities and compliance gaps.
features: Historical tax return and order review
benefits: Uncovers hidden tax liabilities before deals

process.title: Scope Definition
process.description: Define review period and risk areas.

process.title: Detailed Review
process.description: Examine returns, orders, and compliance history.

faqs.question: When is corporate tax due diligence needed?
faqs.answer: Before M&A, private equity investment, or major restructuring.

faqs.question: Does it cover indirect tax too?
faqs.answer: It can be scoped to include GST and other applicable taxes.

faqs.question: What is the deliverable?
faqs.answer: A detailed report of risks with recommended safeguards in the transaction.

Tax Indemnity & Transaction Structuring.shortDescription: Structuring tax indemnities and transaction terms to allocate risk in corporate deals.
Tax Indemnity & Transaction Structuring.longDescription: We draft tax indemnity clauses and structure transaction terms to appropriately allocate identified tax risks between parties in a deal.
features: Tax risk identification from due diligence

process.title: Risk Review
process.description: Understand identified tax risks from diligence.

faqs.question: What is a tax indemnity clause?
faqs.answer: A contractual provision allocating responsibility for pre-closing tax liabilities.

faqs.question: What is an escrow/holdback?
faqs.answer: Funds set aside to cover potential future tax claims post-transaction.

faqs.question: Who typically bears historical tax risk?
faqs.answer: Usually the seller, through indemnity or purchase price adjustment.

Merger & Acquisition Tax Advisory.shortDescription: Tax advisory for M&A transactions covering structuring, due diligence, and post-deal integration.
Merger & Acquisition Tax Advisory.longDescription: We advise on the most tax-efficient structure for mergers and acquisitions, considering stamp duty, capital gains, and post-merger compliance implications.
features: Deal structure tax analysis (share vs asset)
Capital gains and stamp duty assessment

process.title: Tax Impact Assessment
process.description: Assess capital gains, stamp duty, and other taxes.

process.title: Advisory Delivery
process.description: Recommend optimal structure and compliance steps.

faqs.question: Is a merger via NCLT tax-neutral?
faqs.answer: Often yes, if structured to meet conditions under Section 2(1B) of the Income Tax Act.

faqs.question: What is the difference between share and asset deals?
faqs.answer: Share deals transfer ownership; asset deals transfer specific assets/liabilities, each with different tax impacts.

faqs.question: Does stamp duty apply to mergers?
faqs.answer: Yes, typically on the scheme of merger as sanctioned by NCLT.

Corporate Restructuring Tax Advisory.shortDescription: Tax advisory for corporate restructuring including demergers, slump sales, and reorganizations.
Corporate Restructuring Tax Advisory.longDescription: We advise on the tax implications of various restructuring options, helping structure transactions to minimize tax leakage while meeting business objectives.

process.title: Tax Analysis
process.description: Analyze tax implications of restructuring options.

faqs.question: What is a slump sale?
faqs.answer: Transfer of a business undertaking as a whole for a lump-sum consideration.

faqs.question: Is demerger always tax-neutral?
faqs.answer: Only if it meets specific conditions defined under the Income Tax Act.

faqs.question: Does restructuring require NCLT approval?
faqs.answer: Certain forms, like demergers, typically require NCLT sanction.

Capital Gains Tax Advisory.shortDescription: Legal advisory on capital gains tax treatment for corporate asset sales and transactions.
Capital Gains Tax Advisory.longDescription: We advise companies on capital gains implications of asset sales, share transfers, and other transactions, identifying available exemptions and planning opportunities.
benefits: Accurate tax treatment for corporate transactions

faqs.question: Are corporate capital gains taxed differently?
faqs.answer: Rates and exemptions can differ based on entity type and asset held.

faqs.question: Can companies claim reinvestment exemptions?
faqs.answer: Limited exemptions are available depending on the asset and reinvestment type.

faqs.question: Is valuation important for capital gains?
faqs.answer: Yes, especially for unlisted shares subject to fair-market-value rules.

Tax Exemption & Incentive Advisory.shortDescription: Guidance on available tax exemptions and incentives applicable to corporate operations.
Tax Exemption & Incentive Advisory.longDescription: We identify applicable tax holidays, incentives, and exemption schemes relevant to your industry, location, and business activity.

process.title: Condition Analysis
process.description: Review conditions attached to each scheme.

process.title: Advisory Delivery
process.description: Provide application guidance and compliance checklist.

faqs.question: What are common corporate incentives?
faqs.answer: SEZ benefits, startup tax holidays, and state investment incentives, among others.

faqs.question: Can incentives be withdrawn?
faqs.answer: Yes, if compliance conditions are violated during the incentive period.

faqs.question: Do incentives require prior approval?
faqs.answer: Many do; timely application is essential to secure benefits.

Tax Settlement & Dispute Resolution.shortDescription: Legal support for settling tax disputes through available resolution and settlement mechanisms.
Tax Settlement & Dispute Resolution.longDescription: We guide you through available dispute resolution schemes, negotiating settlements that reduce litigation time and cost compared to prolonged proceedings.

faqs.question: What are common settlement schemes?
faqs.answer: Periodic government amnesty and dispute resolution schemes like Vivad Se Vishwas.

faqs.question: Is settlement always beneficial?
faqs.answer: It depends on case strength; strong cases may be better litigated.

faqs.question: Can settlement waive penalties fully?
faqs.answer: Many schemes offer significant penalty and interest waivers.

Corporate Finance Legal Advisory.shortDescription: Legal guidance on corporate finance transactions including debt, equity, and capital structuring.
Corporate Finance Legal Advisory.longDescription: We advise on the legal aspects of corporate finance transactions, structuring debt and equity instruments while ensuring regulatory compliance.

faqs.question: What financing instruments are commonly structured?
faqs.answer: Debt, convertible instruments, preference shares, and hybrid securities.

faqs.question: Is RBI approval needed for foreign financing?
faqs.answer: Depends on the route and instrument; some require prior approval.

faqs.question: What are financial covenants?
faqs.answer: Conditions in financing agreements requiring maintenance of specific financial ratios.

Loan & Financing Documentation.shortDescription: Drafting and reviewing loan agreements, security documents, and financing arrangements.
Loan & Financing Documentation.longDescription: We prepare comprehensive loan and financing documentation, covering terms, security, and covenants to protect your interests in the transaction.

process.title: Terms Review
process.description: Understand loan structure and security offered.

faqs.question: What security types are commonly used?
faqs.answer: Mortgage, pledge of shares, hypothecation, and personal/corporate guarantees.

faqs.question: Is registration of security mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, charges must be registered with MCA and relevant registries.

faqs.question: What happens on default?
faqs.answer: Lenders can enforce security as per agreed terms and applicable law.

Banking & Financial Transactions.shortDescription: Legal support for banking transactions covering documentation, compliance, and dispute resolution.
Banking & Financial Transactions.longDescription: We provide legal support across banking transactions, including documentation review, regulatory compliance, and resolution of banking-related disputes.

process.title: Advisory/Resolution
process.description: Provide guidance or pursue dispute resolution.

faqs.question: What banking disputes are common?
faqs.answer: Loan recovery, guarantee invocation, and documentation discrepancies.

faqs.question: Does RBI regulate all banking transactions?
faqs.answer: Most banking activities fall under RBI's regulatory framework.

faqs.question: Can disputes be resolved outside court?
faqs.answer: Yes, through negotiation, mediation, or banking ombudsman mechanisms.

Corporate Debt Restructuring.shortDescription: Legal advisory and documentation support for restructuring corporate debt obligations.
Corporate Debt Restructuring.longDescription: We assist companies in restructuring debt through negotiated terms with lenders, ensuring compliance with applicable frameworks and documentation.

faqs.question: What frameworks govern debt restructuring?
faqs.answer: RBI's prudential framework and, where applicable, the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.

faqs.question: Does restructuring affect credit rating?
faqs.answer: It can, depending on the nature and reporting of the restructuring.

faqs.question: Is lender consent required?
faqs.answer: Yes, restructuring generally requires agreement from the relevant lenders.

Securities & Investment Advisory.shortDescription: Legal advisory on securities transactions, investment structuring, and regulatory compliance.
Securities & Investment Advisory.longDescription: We advise on legal aspects of securities issuance, investment agreements, and compliance with SEBI and company law requirements.

faqs.question: Does every securities issuance need SEBI compliance?
faqs.answer: Listed company issuances are more heavily regulated; private issuances have lighter requirements.

faqs.question: What is a term sheet?
faqs.answer: A non-binding document outlining key terms before finalizing an investment agreement.

faqs.question: Are foreign investments treated differently?
faqs.answer: Yes, subject to additional FEMA/RBI compliance requirements.

Shareholders & Investment Agreements.shortDescription: Drafting and reviewing shareholder agreements and investment documentation to protect stakeholder interests.
Shareholders & Investment Agreements.longDescription: We draft comprehensive shareholder and investment agreements covering governance, exit rights, and protective provisions for all parties involved.

faqs.question: What is an anti-dilution clause?
faqs.answer: A provision protecting investors from value dilution in future funding rounds.

faqs.question: What are typical exit rights?
faqs.answer: Tag-along, drag-along, and right of first refusal clauses, among others.

faqs.question: Is a shareholders' agreement legally binding?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is a binding contract among the signing shareholders.

Financial Regulatory Compliance.shortDescription: Advisory on compliance with financial sector regulations including RBI, SEBI, and IRDAI requirements.
Financial Regulatory Compliance.longDescription: We help financial and non-financial businesses navigate regulatory requirements applicable to their financial activities, reducing compliance risk.

faqs.question: Who needs financial regulatory compliance advisory?
faqs.answer: NBFCs, fintechs, insurers, and businesses with regulated financial activities.

faqs.question: How often do regulations change?
faqs.answer: Frequently; ongoing monitoring is essential to stay compliant.

faqs.question: What happens on non-compliance?
faqs.answer: Penalties, license suspension, or other regulatory action may follow.

Corporate Guarantees & Securities.shortDescription: Legal advisory and documentation for structuring corporate guarantees and security arrangements.
Corporate Guarantees & Securities.longDescription: We draft and review corporate guarantee documents and related security arrangements, ensuring compliance with Companies Act and lending requirements.

process.title: Compliance Check
process.description: Verify Companies Act and internal approval requirements.

faqs.question: Is board approval required for corporate guarantees?
faqs.answer: Yes, and shareholder approval may also be needed above certain limits.

faqs.question: What is Section 186 of the Companies Act?
faqs.answer: It regulates loans, investments, and guarantees given by a company.

faqs.question: Can a guarantee be revoked?
faqs.answer: Only as per terms agreed, generally requiring lender consent.

Tax & Finance Legal Due Diligence.shortDescription: Combined tax and finance legal due diligence to identify risks before major transactions.
Tax & Finance Legal Due Diligence.longDescription: We conduct integrated tax and finance due diligence covering liabilities, financing arrangements, and compliance gaps ahead of investment or acquisition decisions.

process.title: Scope Definition
process.description: Define diligence scope across tax and finance.

faqs.question: Why combine tax and finance due diligence?
faqs.answer: Many risks overlap, and a combined view gives a more complete transaction picture.

faqs.question: How long does this diligence take?
faqs.answer: Typically 3-5 weeks depending on transaction size and complexity.

faqs.question: Can findings affect deal valuation?
faqs.answer: Yes, identified risks often factor into purchase price or deal terms.
